title: ci(ui-merge): every merge-queue entry runs all four ui lanes because the `ui` filter output falls back to 'true' on merge_group — decide the ui lanes from the diff against `merge_group.base_sha`, as Test Core already does (parent #25677)
body:
Filing gate ③ (maintainer-directed) + ④: aftercare of the ui/ merge (#25752), part of #25677. Touches `.github/workflows/ci.yml` = Tier H: GOVERNED_APPROVERS review, the PR stops at draft.

Maintainer, 2026-10-26 01:45Z, in the project thread that measured post-merge CI speed: 「创建issue」 (asked after reading the ranked fix list; this is item 1).

**谁付代价（业务筛）:** every PR that lands goes through the merge queue. Since the merge, a queue entry that changes only docs, scripts or a core package still runs Test UI (16 shards), Type Check UI, Build & E2E UI and Lint UI. Small entries used to finish in 4–10 min; now their floor is ~16–18 min, and each entry pays ~220 extra runner-minutes. With up to 8 card threads landing in parallel, this is the main post-merge slowdown the fleet feels.

## Measured

- Pre-merge `merge_group` CI runs (2026-10-25, list of 40): small entries 4.0–9.8 min (e.g. 40181079769 4.0, 40195098891 4.9, 40198037200 5.1), core entries 26–30 min.
- Post-merge queue build 40251505048 (#25852): Test UI shards 8.4–17.7 min, Type Check UI 15.5 min, Build & E2E UI 5.0, Lint UI 4.5 — all scheduled although the job's queue base was only one commit behind.
- Cause, `ci.yml` `filter` job: `dorny/paths-filter` runs only on `pull_request` / `push` (`if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'push'`), and the outputs `ui` / `ui_consumers` fall back to `'true'` (`ui: ${{ steps.changes.outputs.ui || 'true' }}`). Test Core does not have this problem: `scripts/ci/select-shard-packages.sh` already scopes merge_group runs with `turbo ls --affected` against `merge_group.base_sha`.

## Wanted

1. On `merge_group`, compute the `ui` and `ui_consumers` outputs from `git diff --name-only <merge_group.base_sha>...HEAD`, using the same globs the `pull_request` filter uses. Fail open: if the base cannot be fetched or the diff fails, the output stays `'true'`.
2. `push` / `schedule` / `workflow_dispatch` keep the full battery (maintainer ruling 2026-10-25 Q6-b: push-to-main runs stay).
3. The workflow's gate rosters follow (`check-ci-filter-parity`, `check-expected-skips`, `check-step-collectors`); each `--self-test` exits 0.

## Acceptance

- A queue entry that changes no `ui/**` file and no `ui_consumers` path shows the four ui lanes as skipped, and the required contexts (`Lint UI`, `Build & E2E UI`, and later `Type Check UI`) still report success. Skipped counts as passing for a required check, so name the run that shows this.
- A queue entry touching `ui/**` still runs all four lanes.
- On the card: queue CI wall time for one small entry before and after.

**Expected saving:** ~220 runner-min per non-ui queue entry; small entries back to 5–10 min. **Size:** S. **Clause-②:** no. **Metadata-protocol:** none.

## Dedupe

`search_issues` 2026-10-26 01:50Z 「merge_group merge queue runs all ui jobs paths filter ui output true」: 5 hits, all closed and unrelated (#19036, #16574, #11621, #9283, #4897). **New.**

Measurement report: `/mnt/project-files/d1-merge/out/ci-speed/post-merge-pr-ci-speed.md` (project thread "Keep PR CI fast after the merge").
